name: Short Cut Italian Marinated Veggie-Chickpea Salad Sandwich with Arugula

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place in a medium bowl along with mayo, salt, and pepper. Using a fork or potato masher, roughly mash chickpea salad until semi-smooth and combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (15 oz) can garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
¼ cup mayonnaise
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and roughly chop pickled veggies. Add to the bowl with the mashed chickpeas and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅔ cup giardiniera (mixed Italian pickled vegetables)

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry arugula (skip if it came pre-washed). Toast buns if desired.
Divide chickpea salad between the bottom half of each bun. Top with arugula, then close with the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!
